en: Dependent on a wholesome state associated with and produced by consciousness (*cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāna*), a state that is neither associated with nor produced by consciousness and is not wholesome arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*)... [There are] three under root condition... up to... three under non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with and produced by consciousness, a state that is neither associated with nor produced by consciousness and is not unwholesome arises by way of root condition...
[There are] three under root condition... up to... three under non-disappearance condition. (The indeterminate root has exactly three conditions.)
